document.abstract: The Antiope Videotex System is composed of two completely separate parts. The Data Transmission System (DIDON) and the Display System (Antiope). The Data Transmission System derives from a CCETT standardized protocol which can be used for teletext as well as for any other kind of data services such as facsimile or remote control. The future availability of a discontinued 819 line television system within France and the possibility of using that network for data broadcast has pushed the development of DIDON and the LSI's required for its use.
